newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Banco do Brasil first half net rises.
newsitem.headline: Banco do Brasil first half net rises.

text.p: Brazilian state-run bank Banco do Brasil posted 1997 first half net profits of 287.7 million reais, compared with a loss of 7.9 billion reais in the same period a year ago, Finance Director Carlos Gilberto Caetano said Monday.
Banco do Brasil showed a 255 million reais net profit in the second half of 1996.
The bank said in a statement its net profit was equal to 0.40 reais per 1,000-share lot.
It said it represented a 5.0 percent return on shareholder equity, giving an annualized rate of 10.2 percent.
